about: Frozen 2026-09-24 from includes/straboClasses/kobofiles/xls (2019 KoBo forms; rock_unit + tephra 2024) by straboModelClass::loadXLSFiles, then the xls were retired. Shapefile import column catalog + legacy field/choice fallbacks. Current labels come from the StraboField forms (includes/fieldvocab).
